BRAND_DESCRIPTION: Second hand in Fuerteventura: send it on WhatsApp and we post it.
HOME_HERO_TEXT: What you no longer use, someone else wants. Send us a photo on WhatsApp and we'll post it for you.
WORKSHOP_INTRO: No accounts, no forms: just WhatsApp. We do the rest.
WORKSHOP_STEP_1_TEXT: Message us on WhatsApp with a photo of what you want to sell and, if you like, the price and a few words.
WORKSHOP_STEP_2_TEXT: We improve the photo with AI, write the listing and check it with you.
WORKSHOP_STEP_3_TEXT: Your listing goes online on Baifo for 3 months. Buyers write to you directly on WhatsApp.
STORE_EMPTY: Listings are coming soon. Want to be the first? Write to us on WhatsApp.
FOOTER_TAGLINE: Second hand in Fuerteventura, on WhatsApp.
CONTACT_RULES_NOT_A_SHOP_TEXT: {shop} publishes second-hand listings from private sellers in Fuerteventura. Buyer and seller agree on the sale directly: {shop} does not sell the items or take payment for them.
HOME_FAQ_1_A: On each listing, tap "Contact the seller" and write to them on WhatsApp. If a listing has no seller, write to us.
